description: This file defines a Polymer behavior 'IronButtonState' that manages button-like states and accessibility features, including properties for pressed, toggles, active state, and keyboard/mouse interactions.

classes.name: Polymer.IronButtonStateImpl
classes.description: An object defining properties, listeners, observers, and methods related to button state management, to be used as a Polymer behavior.

methods.name: _tapHandler
methods.description: Handles tap events; toggles active state if 'toggles' property is true.

methods.name: _detectKeyboardFocus
methods.description: Detects if the element received focus from the keyboard.

methods.name: _userActivate
methods.description: Changes the active state and fires a 'change' event to emulate native checkbox behavior.

methods.name: _downHandler
methods.description: Handles pointer down events; updates 'pointerDown' and 'pressed' states.

methods.name: _upHandler
methods.description: Handles pointer up events; resets 'pointerDown' and 'pressed' states.

methods.name: __isFocusedLightDescendant
methods.description: Checks if a target element is a focused descendant within a light DOM context.

methods.name: _spaceKeyDownHandler
methods.description: Handles space key down; sets pressed state and prevents default behavior.

methods.name: _spaceKeyUpHandler
methods.description: Handles space key up; triggers click if pressed and resets pressed state.

methods.name: _asyncClick
methods.description: Triggers a click asynchronously after a small delay.

methods.name: _activeChanged
methods.description: Updates ARIA attributes and button state when 'active' changes.

methods.name: _controlStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to control state, especially when disabled.

methods.name: _changedButtonState
methods.description: Hook for subclasses or behaviors to react to button state changes.
